name: ${mod_name}
description: An unofficial port of GTNH NotEnoughItems features to Just Enough Items: bookmark groups and recipe chains, the crafting tree window, favorite recipes, autocrafting, pulling items from chests, chat links, highlight tips and a crafting calculator. Not affiliated with the NotEnoughItems authors.

custom.credits: Recipe tree, favorites, crafting-chain maths and the bookmark layout are ported from GTNH NotEnoughItems (https://github.com/GTNewHorizons/NotEnoughItems, LGPL-3.0-or-later) by Chicken-Bones, GTNewHorizons and the NotEnoughItems contributors; the crafting tree texture (craftingtree.png) is from NotEnoughItems too
